source.name: Guardian Greaves
source.description:
Enables quick movement

Active ability: Activates when many allied chess pieces are injured.
Grants 500 maximum health and 30 mana to all allied units in the area and dispels negative effects incurred during battle.

Effect Range:500
source.lore: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.
